questions_validation_metadata_check.name: questions_validation_metadata_check
questions_validation_metadata_check.value: "questions"."status" <> 'VALIDATED' OR ("questions"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."validated_by" IS NOT NULL)

quiz_sessions_dates_order_check.name: quiz_sessions_dates_order_check
quiz_sessions_dates_order_check.value: "quiz_sessions"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "quiz_sessions"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "quiz_sessions"."ends_at" > "quiz_sessions"."starts_at"

rewards_attribution_rule_check.name: rewards_attribution_rule_check
rewards_attribution_rule_check.value: "rewards"."award_position" IS NOT NULL OR "rewards"."award_condition" IS NOT NULL

session_questions_dates_order_check.name: session_questions_dates_order_check
session_questions_dates_order_check.value: "session_questions"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "session_questions"."closes_at" IS NULL OR "session_questions"."closes_at" > "session_questions"."opens_at"

session_questions_reveal_order_check.name: session_questions_reveal_order_check
session_questions_reveal_order_check.value: "session_questions"."revealed_at" IS NULL OR "session_questions"."closes_at" IS NULL OR "session_questions"."revealed_at" >= "session_questions"."closes_at"
